positive_snippets: The best hotel for stay very comfortable Room Manager behaviour is very good 👍😊
negative_snippets: I had a confirmed booking at this hotel, but the staff denied providing the room on arrival and attempted to shift me to a different property by sharing another location on WhatsApp. Later, they falsely claimed that I never visited the hotel. This was a clear case of denying a confirmed booking and trying to relocate the guest without consent. Please ensure room availability before accepting bookings.

My overall experience at this hotel was below expectations. The check-in process, however, was smooth and hassle-free. The person at the reception was very polite, professional, and communicative, which created a good first impression.

Unfortunately, the service quality after check-in did not match that initial impression. Room service was extremely slow, and every small request took a long time to be fulfilled. Staff coordination seemed poor, and it often felt like there was a lack of proper management. I also had to follow up multiple times just to get the GST bill, which was quite inconvenient for a business traveler.

Before arrival, I had informed the hotel about my early check-in plan, and they had confirmed it. However, when I reached the property in the morning, there was no staff present at the reception desk. I had to wait for quite some time before someone arrived, which was disappointing.

Overall, while the reception team was courteous and the initial check-in experience went well, the overall service standards and responsiveness need major improvement. The hotel management should focus on faster service, better staff availability, and timely support for guest requirements. With a few improvements in these areas, the guest experience could become significantly better.
